title: Measured & Reported Data
subtitle: 4 measured data source types with direct and hybrid processing paths. Reconciled at the aggregator.

cems.title: CEMS
cems.desc: Real-time stack monitoring with 15-min data intervals. Direct GHG measurement.

utility.title: Utility Meters
utility.desc: Electricity, gas, water, and steam meters with automated reading capture.

verified.title: 3rd-Party Verified
verified.desc: Externally audited data from certified verification bodies (SGS, Bureau Veritas, etc.).

lab.title: Stack Tests / Lab
lab.desc: Periodic emission sampling, fuel analysis, and material composition testing.

normalise.title: Format Normalisation
normalise.desc: Convert units, standardise timestamps, align intervals

qa.title: Quality Assurance
qa.desc: Outlier detection, gap filling, completeness scoring

classify.title: Classification & Scope Tagging
classify.desc: Map to GHG scope, assign source categories

direct.title: Direct Path
direct.subtitle: Bypass Calculator
direct.desc: Pre-calculated or directly measured emissions — no calculator module needed. CEMS data and verified totals go here.

hybrid.title: Hybrid Path
hybrid.subtitle: Partial Calculation Required
hybrid.desc: Measured activity data that still needs emission factor application or unit conversion through a calculator module.

rules.cemsVsCalc: CEMS vs calculated: prefer CEMS when delta < 5%
rules.meterVsInvoice: Utility meter vs invoice: flag if delta > 2%
rules.verifiedOverride: Verified totals override calculated when certified
rules.labOverride: Lab results override EFs for tested fuel batches
rules.gapFill: Gap-fill rule: interpolate up to 72hr CEMS gaps

cems.reason: Direct GHG measurement, no calculation needed

electricity.reason: kWh measured, needs grid EF application

fuel.reason: Composition data routes to combustion calc
